plain: The story is that Admiral Richard Byrd, the American polar explorer, had some strange encounter in Antarctica. Michels raises it with a guest simply by asking, "Do you know Admiral Richard Byrd?" Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, mentions it on another episode second hand, crediting a diver named Becky Schott and placing it in the 1940s: "someone thought that Admiral Byrd had some encounter when he was down there." If true, something unexplained would have been met at the bottom of the world.
